Name: Chubby Junimo Cat Replacement
Author: tolerdesigns
Description:
[quote][size=4]Poor Chubby Junimo...All he wants to do is relax and be lazy!  [i]"I don't want to build a pantry, or fix a mine-cart! All the junimo's do is work, work, work!"[/i] Says poor Chubby Junimo...But what's this!? ...A new farmer has come to Stardew Valley!  [i]"I will pretend to be a cat!"[/i] He thought.  [i]"I can act like a cat, meow like a cat! The new farmer will take me in for sure!"[/i] Chubby Junimo could now eat and be lazy to his hearts content on the new farm!  Rejoice one and all![/size][/quote][b][color=#e69138][size=4][img]http://i.imgur.com/seg6p10.gif[/img] [/size][/color][/b][img]http://i.imgur.com/nvl6Hft.gif[/img][b][color=#e69138][size=4] [img]http://i.imgur.com/rZakwfG.gif[/img] [img]http://i.imgur.com/FIIdt5z.gif[/img]
[u]
DESCRIPTION OF MOD:[/u]

[/size][/color][/b]This mod replaces the cat sprite to a chubby junimo wearing cat ears.  Why wouldn't you want this?

I have also as an optional file replaced the sprite on the User Interface menu that shows the cats face, and I have also replaced the dialogue that Marnie speaks in the first event giving you the cat.
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1029/?]
[/url]
[b][u][size=4][color=#e69138]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/color]
[/size][/u]
MAIN FILE INSTRUCTIONS:[/b]

[list]
[*]This mod replaces the original sprite .xnb file found in Content\Animals. Please make a backup of the original files. 
[*]Unzip or extract the file for the sprite to replace after downloading.
[*]Place (or replace) the file(s) into the Stardew Valley folder under Content\Animals.
[/list]
[b]OPTIONAL INSTRUCTIONS:[/b]

I have placed two optional files, one will replace the first event dialogue where Marnie gives you the cat.  It adds some curiosity on her end on if it's "really a cat". The other file changes the Cursors.xnb so when you open up your menu is shows the Junimo cat rather than the actual cat sprite face.  These will cause conflicts with any other mod that alters UI replacements or Cursors.xnb, and any mod that alters events within the Farm.xnb.

[list]
[*]Cat Event Dialogue Replacement is the Farm.xnb, and should be placed in Content\Data\Events
[*]The UI Menu sprite Replacement is the Cursors.xnb, and should be placed in Content\LooseSprites
[/list]
